dialogues.speaker: Boncza
dialogues.text: Welcome! If you need anything explained, just give me a holler!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to ask for directions...

dialogues.speaker: Boncza
dialogues.text: Oh hey, you're new here, aint'cha? Good thing you ran into me. Nasha Town's far from a safe haven, and if you go around asking questions like that, you'll be eating more scams than krumkakes.

dialogues.speaker: Boncza
dialogues.text: If you're here on vacation, I recommend taking a walk around the square in front of the merchant guild. The scenery's whatever, but you can swing by "Mead-Boy" and snag some Snezhnayan souvenirs to bring back home. Lots of people do that.

dialogues.speaker: Boncza
dialogues.text: If you're strapped for Mora and looking to amend that, I recommend you head to The Flagship and look for Kruchek. I hear that the jobs he offers pay pretty well!

dialogues.speaker: Boncza
dialogues.text: If you're here for business, though, you should make a beeline for the Voynich Guild. Get the latest market scoop from them before stocking up on anything. That way, you won't make any losses!

dialogues.speaker: Boncza
dialogues.text: Oh, don't be like that. Nasha Town's full of twists and turns, and there are cheats around every corner, waiting to prey on the unsuspecting — and foreign-looking — traveler. You'll land yourself in hot water if you just wander around.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, I'm in a bit of a rush.

dialogues.speaker: Boncza
dialogues.text: Ah... I'll be sure to give you a proper introduction to Nasha Town next time, then!

dialogues.speaker: Boncza
dialogues.text: I'm sure my recommendations are correct. I'm the guard here, after all. Why would I lie to you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay, so who are these "scammers" you keep going on about?

dialogues.speaker: Boncza
dialogues.text: Well! I can't just... expose them to outsiders, right? How else am I supposed to make a living...?

dialogues.speaker: Boncza
dialogues.text: I—In any case, if you want to go in and look around, Kruchek from The Flagship, Golitsyna from Mead-Boy, and Cairuo from the market are all good people.

dialogues.speaker: Boncza
dialogues.text: As for other places... You should be careful about spending money there. Don't say I didn't warn you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, so you were the real scammer all along.

dialogues.speaker: Boncza
dialogues.text: H—Huh? Me, a guard? A scammer? Don't be ridiculous! You couldn't teach me to lie even if both our lives depended on it! Seriously, the nerve of some people...
